title: Carnevale–Voll polynomial nonvanishing conjecture
statement:
For positive integers $\lambda_1>\lambda_2$, define

$$
C_{\lambda_1,\lambda_2}(x,1)=\sum_{j=0}^{\lambda_2}{\lambda_1\choose j}{\lambda_2\choose j}x^j.
$$

**Carnevale–Voll conjecture.**

$$
C_{\lambda_1,\lambda_2}(-1,1)\neq0.
$$

This is the formulation of Carnevale and Voll's Conjecture A relevant to the absence of unitary factors in their polynomial. The paper proves the assertion in several parameter ranges and studies its asymptotic validity, while the full conjecture remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.09704

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2020).
source_name: Laurent Habsieger, “Explicit Asymptotics for Signed Binomial Sums and Applications to Carnevale-Voll Conjecture”, arXiv:2006.09704 (2020).
